headline.interpretation: Robust-yet-fragile confirmed. The first twelve targeted removals cost 31 cities between them. The thirteenth, Porthcurno, severs 278. Random removal of 88 cities, 6.8 times more nodes, costs 14 percent of the giant component. The static articulation set understates this because articulation structure regenerates under attack: it plateaus at 0.3904 and never reaches the half-collapse threshold.
